name: LawBench

evaluation.primary_metric: Overall average score across 20 tasks (task-specific metrics include ROUGE-L, Accuracy, F0.5, F1, rc-F1, soft-F1, and normalized log-distance)
evaluation.harbor_aligned_metric: Accuracy (%) on a 120-unit LawBench Harbor parity subset (20 scenarios × 2 prompt types × 3 chunks), averaged over 3 runs; parity: qwen-code@0.6.0 + glm-4.7; 65.6 ± 1.0 (Harbor) vs 65.0 ± 0.4 (original)

results_over_time.note: Official paper results. LawBench evaluates Chinese legal tasks. The main ranking is based on average task performance.

notes: Chinese legal benchmark under the Chinese civil law system. Contains 20 tasks across 3 cognitive levels: memorization, understanding, and application.
